arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose id is a multiple of 100, which is a fixed 1% slice of all transactions for manual review. It is a deterministic stand-in for a random sample, so the same transactions are flagged every time.
assumptions: A rule cannot call random(), so I used transaction id modulo 100 = 0 as a fixed 1% sample.
The sample is spread across all transactions regardless of amount, card, merchant or fraud status.
Ids are assumed to be unrelated to fraud, so the slice should look like a random 1% draw.
